assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy.
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271) is clinically indicated to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy.
